title: Hearing Services Administration Act 1997
converter: cth_convert_sym_v10.py (a copy of docx_text() of the workbench converter harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py that also maps Symbol-font and private-use characters; kept outside the repository); the first deposit used harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py

symbol_repair_2026_11_07.previous_converter: harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py (docx_text), the converter of the 2026-10-13 deposit
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.from: the same Word document of C2024C00689 (download_sha256 6048a6789e9e6ea5f358962f943113a3346a9cc1c9dc72468f930a39bfe29073, unchanged)
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.why: The Act types the list marker of the simplified outline of Part 6 as text in the Symbol font, which docx_text() kept as a raw private-use code point (U+F0B7) that displays as an empty box. cth_convert_sym_v10.py maps such code points and Symbol-font w:sym elements to Unicode and Wingdings boxes to "[ ]"; run with its mapping switched off it reproduces the first deposit byte for byte.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.what_changed: A diff against the first deposit shows one line changed (same 606 lines, same 42,642 characters): line 319, the bullet of the simplified outline of Part 6 (section 36), U+F0B7 -> •. No word or number changed.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.encodings_affected: The subject has no encoding, and no other file records the text hash; there is no formulas sidecar.
